review_status: Source-linked draft; not independently clinically reviewed
coverage: Selected evidence for BCG/TB, including a global 2021 prevalence reference, published disability weight and an illustrative morbidity calculation. Childhood vaccine effects remain separate from all-age burden data. Not an exhaustive or clinically validated dataset.

personalisation.reason: Age, sex and regional matching are not established for this dataset.

estimates.population: Global general population; all ages and vaccination histories
estimates.limitations: Not prevalence, an unvaccinated baseline or an individual probability; not mapped to this website’s geographic groups.

estimates.population: Participants vaccinated as infants in randomised trials
estimates.time_period: Follow-up differs across trials; not a single 12-month estimate
estimates.limitations: Infant subgroup; protection differs by setting, age and prior mycobacterial sensitisation. Cannot be combined with global all-age incidence to calculate personal absolute benefit.

estimates.population: Participants vaccinated as infants in randomised trials
estimates.limitations: Wide confidence interval for severe disease; not an absolute number of cases prevented.

estimates.population: Children younger than 5 years among contacts of people with TB, with BCG given in infancy
estimates.region: 26 cohorts in 17 countries across the full review
estimates.comparator: Infant BCG versus no infant BCG, adjusted analysis
estimates.limitations: Odds ratio, not risk ratio. Residual confounding remains possible. Do not compare crude pooled counts as if randomised, or treat this as a trial efficacy estimate.

estimates.time_period: Usually begins after 2 or more weeks; healing and scarring over months
estimates.limitations: Expected local response is not equivalent to a serious adverse event; no exact percentage or excess versus control is supplied.

estimates.outcome: Suppurative lymphadenitis (a lymph node with pus)
estimates.population: Recipients covered by BCG Vaccine AJV product information; not age-stratified
estimates.time_period: No fixed observation window given in the frequency table
estimates.limitations: Product-label category, not a confidence interval, measured excess risk or rate for every BCG product.

estimates.population: Recipients covered by BCG Vaccine AJV product information; not age-stratified
estimates.time_period: No fixed observation window given in the frequency table
estimates.limitations: Product-label category; not a controlled excess-risk estimate.

estimates.outcome: TB prevalence as reported in the GBD 2021 analysis
estimates.population: Global, both sexes, age-standardised reference population
estimates.time_period: 2021; not a 12-month risk of developing TB
estimates.design: Secondary analysis of GBD modelled estimates
estimates.limitations: Age-standardised rate for comparisons, not the proportion in the actual current population or a personal probability. Case-definition and HIV-scope compatibility require extraction-level audit before clinical use; do not equate with latent infection prevalence or WHO 2024 incidence.

estimates.outcome: Disability weight for the TB health state without HIV infection
estimates.population: Symptomatic TB health state, not HIV infected; reference health-state valuation
estimates.time_period: Health-state weight; not a follow-up period or probability
estimates.design: Published health-state disability weight used in WHO GHE
estimates.limitations: Quantifies non-fatal health loss for this health state. It is not case fatality, a personal prognosis, or a validated composite-risk score. Applying it uniformly to all prevalent TB assumes a compatible symptom and HIV case mix; that assumption has not been audited here.

estimates.outcome: Death during treatment of childhood TB meningitis
estimates.population: Children treated for TB meningitis in 19 studies (1,636 children in the review)
estimates.time_period: During treatment; studies published through October 2012, varying follow-up
estimates.limitations: Historical treated meningitis cohorts, not all TB, not untreated disease, not a modern individual prognosis. Not used as the severity weight in the index.

estimates.outcome: Neurological sequelae following childhood TB meningitis
estimates.population: Survivors of treated childhood TB meningitis in the review
estimates.time_period: Follow-up varied; studies published through October 2012
estimates.limitations: Conditional on survival; must not be added to the death percentage or applied to all TB. Not an input to the burden index.

method_notes: Null means not assessed or not available, never zero.
Relative rate reductions are derived from published rate ratios; adjusted odds ratios remain odds ratios.
Global incidence, infant efficacy and product-label safety categories describe different populations and time windows. They are not combined into a net-benefit score.
Source checking is not independent clinical validation. Funding, conflicts, individual trial exclusions and completeness of current evidence require further review.
Exploratory model added: prevalence multiplied by a published disability weight. This is an explicit simplifying assumption, not an audited estimate of total TB burden or a validated risk score.
Childhood meningitis severity outcomes are conditional on different denominators and are not multiplied into the global prevalence or added together.

world_map.title: TB occurrence around the world
world_map.measure: Estimated annual TB incidence per 100,000 population
world_map.alt: World map of estimated TB incidence by country in 2024, in annual new and recurrent cases per 100,000 people. Lower incidence is shown in green, higher incidence in red, and missing data in grey. Original WHO numerical legend categories are retained.
world_map.limitations: Country-level annual incidence, not prevalence, an individual prediction, or the website’s custom regional averages. Map boundaries and categories are those of the original WHO figure.
world_map.display_palette: Frontend colour adaptation: green = lower incidence, red = higher incidence; neutral text, boundaries and missing-data grey retained. Underlying source image, country values and numerical categories unchanged.

research_model.label: Illustrative morbidity index using sourced inputs
research_model.scope: Global 2021 age-standardised reference; not personalised by age, sex or selected region
assumptions: Apply the symptomatic, HIV-negative TB health-state weight uniformly to the reported prevalence. Symptom distribution, case-definition and HIV-scope compatibility are not independently audited.
The 2021 prevalence reference is not substituted for WHO 2024 incidence or combined with infant BCG efficacy.
excludes: Post-TB sequelae not represented in the selected health state
research_model.uncertainty_note: Input prevalence uncertainty is shown separately. No joint model uncertainty interval has been estimated; the point output is not precise clinical evidence.

model_scope_note: The research_model is an illustrative morbidity proxy, not complete disease risk. Clinical/personal outputs in missing_data remain unavailable.
